benchmark.summary: No independent review has yet established that the integrated 3D game reaches the fixed reference quality. Implementation and passing software checks alone do not establish visual parity.

changes: The flat map has become a real 3D sandstone garden with original articulated explorer and warden models, disclosed keys, gates, traps and an exit portal.
Follow, close and overview cameras, a true public-data minimap, optional original audio, captions, reduced motion, high contrast and clean feed are integrated.
Lost graphics now reveal a live map immediately, offer a retry and restore 3D after the graphics context returns. Actual run results remain visible in map mode.
Cumulative steps now come from the public snapshot rather than a truncated trail. Garden discovered reflects the actual disclosed area, including after escape.
A new revision is replacing the water pattern, enlarging ruin landmarks and strengthening the explorer silhouette. Fresh captures and reviews are underway.
nextGaps: Compare the latest environment and character revisions against the same fixed references.
Inspect the warden in a real encounter and review movement, turns, celebration and loss reactions.
Verify terminal-state labels, repeated-run resource stability and the complete regression suite.
Measure graphics performance on a hardware GPU; current captures use software WebGL.

reviews.title: Environment comparison · first pass
reviews.summary: The scene still reads as a repetitive flat maze board. Improve architectural hierarchy, focal landmarks, garden scale and material richness. The fixed bar has not been lowered.

reviews.title: Environment comparison · second pass
reviews.summary: The candidate remains a shallow corridor network. Substantial architecture, quieter water, stronger material separation and grouped foliage are the highest-value changes.

reviews.title: Character comparison · first pass
reviews.summary: The 3D explorer has a distinct identity, but the amber/ivory body merges into sandstone at gameplay scale. Broader colour masses, simpler facial detail and clearer pose are needed; warden and motion evidence pending.

verification.name: Public snapshot and route motion
verification.detail: Cumulative steps remain accurate after 240 trail entries; skipped turns, missing continuity, walls, unknown cells and run boundaries are covered.

verification.name: Browser recovery and progress truth
verification.detail: Forced context loss retains a live map, restoration returns to 3D, unavailable WebGL preserves an actual escape result, and the journal displays critic verdicts.

verification.name: Desktop and mobile presentation
verification.detail: The running view, public-data boundary, serialized polling, controls, portrait and landscape remain usable. New UI refinements are under review.

verification.name: Independent visual comparison
verification.detail: Environment and character critics have not established parity. Stills do not establish animation or audio quality.

verification.name: Performance
verification.detail: The capture manifest contains measured frame times and resource counts. No console-quality or 60 fps claim is being made.
